# Auroraflow

> Auroraflow is an LGBTQ-owned massage and skincare spa in downtown Durham, NC. Founded by Castle Frame and Lauren McCullough, it offers inclusive, affirming massage, facial, and bodywork services built on the belief that wellness is a human right for every body.

## Basics

- Location: 607 William Vickers Ave, Durham, NC 27701
- Phone: (919) 229-9555
- Hours: Mon 9am–6pm, Tue–Fri 9am–8pm, Sat–Sun 9am–6pm
- Booking: https://booking.mangomint.com/814946
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/auroraflowmassage/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/auroraflowmassage

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.auroraflow.com/): Overview of Auroraflow and its mission.
- [About](https://www.auroraflow.com/about.html): Our story, founders, and mission.
- [Services](https://www.auroraflow.com/services.html): Full list of massage, facial, waxing, and bodywork services, with pricing.
- [Team](https://www.auroraflow.com/team.html): Licensed massage therapists and estheticians, with individual bios.
- [Memberships](https://www.auroraflow.com/memberships.html): Monthly membership plans for individuals and businesses.
- [Pay What You Can](https://www.auroraflow.com/pay-what-you-can.html): Sliding-scale pricing days to make wellness accessible.
- [Community Fund](https://www.auroraflow.com/community-fund.html): Financial assistance program removing cost barriers to care.
- [Classes](https://www.auroraflow.com/classes.html): Community wellness classes and events.
- [Policies](https://www.auroraflow.com/policies.html): Booking, cancellation, accessibility, and care policies.
- [Contact](https://www.auroraflow.com/contact.html): Location, hours, and how to reach us.

## Notes

- Auroraflow is LGBTQ-owned and built as a safe, inclusive space for LGBTQIA+ and other marginalized communities.
- Services include therapeutic massage, deep tissue, Swedish, Ashiatsu, prenatal, sports, and craniosacral massage; reflexology; cupping; hot stone massage; Reiki; guided energy work; and a range of facials, chemical peels, and waxing (including gender-affirming waxing).
- Financial accessibility programs (Community Fund, Pay What You Can Days) are core to how Auroraflow operates and differentiate it from most spas in the Durham area.
